notes.title: Random Dungeon Exploration
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Chaos Theory Update[/h1]

[h2]New Feature: Random Dungeon Crawler[/h2]

We are thrilled to announce the latest update to Chaos Theory, introducing an exhilarating new feature that adds a dynamic twist to your adventure!

[h3]Random Dungeon Crawler:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Explore Uncharted Depths:[/b] Venture into randomly generated dungeons teeming with danger and excitement. Each dungeon offers a unique layout and varying levels of difficulty, ensuring that no two expeditions are ever the same.
[*][b]Challenge and Reward:[/b] Face off against formidable enemies, navigate treacherous traps, and solve intricate puzzles. The deeper you delve, the greater the challenges—and the more rewarding the loot!
[*][b]Loot and Legacy:[/b] Gather valuable resources, rare items, and powerful artifacts during your dungeon runs. Bring your hard-earned treasures back to your village to enhance and expand your growing settlement.
[*][b]Village Development:[/b] Use the spoils from your dungeon adventures to upgrade buildings, unlock new technologies, and recruit specialized villagers. Watch your village thrive as you integrate the riches of your explorations.
[*][b]Heroic Customization:[/b] Equip your heroes with the best gear and abilities found within the dungeons. Tailor your characters to fit your playstyle and optimize your strategies for both village management and dungeon crawling.
[/list]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Randomly Generated Dungeons:[/b] Infinite replayability with procedurally generated dungeons offering a fresh experience every time you play.
[*][b]Difficulty Levels:[/b] Choose your challenge. Enter dungeons that match your skill level or push your limits for greater rewards.
[*][b]Enhanced Combat Mechanics:[/b] Refined combat system with new enemy types and AI behaviors to keep you on your toes.
[*][b]New Loot System:[/b] Expanded inventory with a variety of new items, weapons, and armor to discover and utilize.
[/list]

Dive into the depths of Chaos Theory’s new dungeon crawler experience and witness your village prosper like never before. Sharpen your blades, ready your spells, and embark on a journey filled with peril and promise.

[b]Update your game now and let the adventure begin![/b]

notes.title: Update version 0.2 released!
notes.content:
We finally have a major release for you guys! Within this update you will now have a whole suite of new graphical assets along with some amazing new features. 

I have personally been working very hard to bring the Chaos Theory Pirates features over to Chaos Theory along with implementing some amazing new graphical assets from Synty Studios.

notes.title: Chaos Theory: Latest Update March 2019
notes.content:
We released the first version of [b]Chaos Theory[/b] on the 1st February, and so far, so good! We’re really appreciative of all of your comments, both positive and negative - every opinion is taken on board and used to improve gameplay!

At the moment, [b]Chaos Theory Studios[/b] is a one-man-band, which means I’m developing the game in my spare time.

In the next release of [b]Chaos Theory[/b], you’ll be able to save the game - I’m making that a priority. 

There will also be an in-game feedback system, so I can accurately track all bugs and comments - so please use that moving forward!

There will also be the ability to switch between characters, either after PERMADEATH or during gameplay. I’d like to make it a kind of spirit that can transfer consciousness into another character -  if you have thoughts on this, let me know.

I intend to frequently release updates, so keep checking back!

When you buy the game, you’re investing into the future development of [b]Chaos Theory[/b]. I have huge ambitions for [b]Chaos Theory[/b], and it will be a never-ending development project.

I’m always on the hunt for new and upcoming talent to collaborate with, so feel free to get in touch if you’d like to contribute.

Thanks,

Scott
Chaos Theory Studios
